entries.rationale: fast-uri is a transitive dependency of ajv, reaching prod only through @cloudflare/tanstack-ai's LLM tool/response JSON-schema validation (and the shadcn build-time CLI, which is dev-only). The advisory (host confusion via a literal backslash authority delimiter) only matters when an untrusted URL is parsed with fast-uri to make a security/routing decision about its host — cubby never does that; ajv's uri-format check validates schema-shaped strings, not attacker-controlled hosts. Patched in >=3.1.4, but forcing that via a pnpm override triggers a full lockfile re-resolve that pulls in NEW critical advisories (seroval, effect), so the real fix is deferred to a dedicated dependency-bump PR where that churn can be reviewed in isolation.
